instruction: Make retry recovery distinguish a complete existing selection from a partial marker-only handoff. When the exact CURATOR task and selection intent match but the receipt is absent, resume receipt creation instead of rejecting the selection; add interruption coverage at that boundary.

findings.summary: An interruption after writing the source-task selection marker but before writing the selection receipt leaves an unrecoverable partial handoff: retry exits because the source already has a current CURATOR owner and never completes the missing receipt.

evidence_refs.lines: The early existingCuratorTaskId check throws before recovery, while the source marker is written before the selection receipt later in createExtractionTasks.
Trace a published item. Expected: source refs, task/PR decision, CURATOR result, and apply receipt are complete.
